enhancementPasses.scope: P0 payroll access and core employee eligibility; payroll activation evidence
changes: Shared read-only active employee eligibility: approved Malaysia-time exit dates and account binding.
Payroll rejects linked inactive/exited accounts before processing reads, writes or idempotent replay.
HR Service Desk and Payroll reject ambiguous active identities; Payroll also refuses conflicting case-insensitive directory identities.
Payroll readiness identifies accepted parallel months and each outstanding rule-version verification using the existing activation conditions.

enhancementPasses.scope: Employee Master and approved dated appointment integration
changes: Academic and Payroll now consume approved assignment, role and institutional-entity state from the existing Position & Role Library.
Academic reads and transactional grant assertions enforce effective assignment/role/entity dates and active institutional entities; no title-based or automatic permission grants.

Payroll uses effective appointment dates for the relevant payroll month and includes role/entity revisions in calculation fingerprints. Archived/invalid appointments require review instead of entering a calculation as current.

Employee projection batches reject stale employee identities, directory fields, profile sections, appointment/role/entity sources and prior sync state. Canonical links, history, audit and integration events remain atomic per employee.
Repeated synchronisation remains idempotent; a refresh retries from current sources without duplicate events or history.
P&C homepage adds a read-only aggregate check of active employee/person/employment links and case-insensitive email collisions.
